purpose: Teach: 乳児/遺骨/銃弾/勾留/留置/採血/病的/課さ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、乳児の発達心理学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered research on infant developmental psychology in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Clear teacher's opening, the name delivered warmly. Even pace, gentle confirming rise on the tag ending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦死者の遺骨収集の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, and I covered historical research on recovering the remains of soldiers who died in the war.
lines.style: Quick eager yes, then steadying into careful precision. Slightly breathy, earnest push through the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、銃弾の弾道学の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered research on bullet ballistics in your paper too, didn't you.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful delivery. Slight slowing on the technical term, warm approval underneath the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、勾留期間の刑事訴訟法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered criminal procedure research on pretrial detention periods.
lines.style: Prompt affirmation, then deliberate pace through the legal phrasing. Quiet pride creeping in at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、留置施設の処遇研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you dealt with research on how detainees are treated in police holding facilities, didn't you.
lines.style: Soft reflective tone. Unhurried, the confirming tag landing gently, inviting rather than testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、採血、つまり血液採取の医学的標準研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on medical standards for blood sampling — drawing blood, that is.
lines.style: Careful, diligent pace through the clarifying phrase. Steady delivery, faint nervous exhale afterward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病的肥満の医学社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you addressed medical-sociology research on morbid obesity as well, didn't you.
lines.style: Slightly lowered voice for the heavier topic. Slow, respectful pace, still warm at the edges.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、法律で課された規制の経済影響研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on the economic impact of regulations imposed by law.
lines.style: Final answer delivered with settled confidence. Even pace, small relieved release on the last words.
